title: angelica archangelica subsp. litoralis
intro: Angelica archangelica subsp. litoralis, commonly known as coastal angelica, is a subspecies of the Angelica archangelica plant, a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of coastal angelica include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable remedy for treating coughs, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of coastal angelica include volatile oils, flavonoids, and lignans, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
